_doc: Texture styles for b2tools/models_interior.py: Black 2 map textures (tex = texture name, src = map texture set a/0/1/4 entry it is copied from; the installer merges them into the zone's area texture set losslessly). size = units per floor repeat, u_size = units per wall repeat (the wall texture spans the whole wall height once), stretch = one genkan texture per exit notch. black = the wall caps, cut faces and lips (Black 2 draws them black).

house._doc: Floccesy/Aspertia houses (texture set 349): striped wallpaper with a wood wainscot (m_h05_kabe, chunk 977), honey wood planks (m_b08_yuka, chunk 1049), stone entrance (m_b08_genkan)
